summary: Inventory shows in-stock but checkout blocks purchase
description:
SKU WIDGET-42 shows 120 units in admin but storefront reports out of stock.

INV-lag detected between inventory-api and edge cache.
Store ID: STORE-11bb22cc-33dd-44ee-55ff-66aa77bb88cc
Last sync job: INV-Sync-2026-03-01T08:00:00Z

comments.author: inventory-oncall
comments.body: Root cause: Redis TTL 5m while warehouse feed runs every 15m. Fixed by aligning cache invalidation with sync webhook.
